highLevelGoal: Build Orca-Strator into a Windows-first autonomous multi-repository AI development orchestrator according to the locked architecture and roadmap.

checkpoint.summary: Mandatory deep review of Change 001 completed and the milestone was not accepted. The overall controller/UI/Electron separation is directionally sound, but review found several foundation defects that must be corrected before watcher work: root npm run dev does not launch a controller runtime or Electron; fresh-checkout workspace commands may depend on untracked @orca/shared dist output; committed React/Vite/Tailwind/Vitest/Electron lines drift materially from the locked technology baseline; migration body + schema_migrations record are not transactional; WebSocket reconnect lifecycle is incorrect across disconnect/error/React StrictMode; hash routing does not satisfy the documented pathname deep-link reload contract; Sol conversation URL validation accepts generic ChatGPT paths; and acceptance evidence/documentation overclaimed some behaviors. Focused corrective OpenSpec 001a has been created with regression requirements and tasks.
checkpoint.lastCompletedTask: Deep Sol/ChatGPT review of Change 001 and creation of corrective OpenSpec 001a
checkpoint.lastVerification: Repository review was performed against main commit e2d1608fab28f29875fa0d8b5d8d738133362d4b. GitHub reports no commit status checks for that commit. Review inspected package manifests/lockfile, controller migration/static/API code, shared validation, UI routing/API/WebSocket code, desktop shell/dev supervisor, tests, tasks, and waypoint. Change 001 remains unaccepted until 001a is implemented and re-reviewed.
